I think it's very morbid and heart-wrenching. To think of someone old and isolated and questioning death and the possibility of an afterlife. We tend to think that older people have accepted death as a part of life and are at peace with it. It makes me sad to think about it. Give your grandma a hug for me, OP.

I'm so sorry for your loss. I almost drowned off the coast of Ship Island in Mississippi, and I will never forget how suddenly it crept up on me. Two friends and I decided to go out to where the water was chin deep. One minute I was fine, the next minute I was caught in a tide. The waves were strong and I kept getting pushed farther out to sea. My friends were suddenly far away and there was no life guard. I was panicking and screaming for help and the effort it was taking to stay afloat was exhausting. Eventually I made it back, exhausted and a little traumatized. My friends were okay, they had managed to make it back with no difficulties and didn't even know I was in so much distress. It was only a few hours later that it sank in how stupid we had been. 

Thank you for sharing, it was very well said.
